//: Every dependency in this repo is pinned to an exact version, deliberately. That is
the right call — it makes builds reproducible and a version change a reviewable
diff — but it only works with something to do the bumping. Unautomated exact pins
do not stay current; they rot quietly until an urgent security patch turns into a
day of untangling eighteen months of drift.
Grouped into a handful of PRs rather than one per package, because this is a
solo project and thirty open PRs is the same as zero.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Security fixes go out immediately, ungrouped and unscheduled.
Patch and minor updates to dev tooling — low risk, one PR.
The React/Next set moves together or not at all.
Likewise the ESLint set — a plugin ahead of its core tends to break flat config.
Hono and its middleware are versioned together upstream.
Drizzle ORM and kit must stay in step or migrations misbehave.
Majors arrive one at a time and never grouped — each deserves its own read.
TypeScript majors move the whole repo. Approve deliberately.
